title: Mask pii and financial fields in find and aggregate tool results
description: In the mongodb-mcp-server checkout (applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server, TypeScript/pnpm, pinned commit aaa72a040db4c32f3d6488d5e28e2892a68e9ee0), add a shared field-masking transform driven by the pii and financial data classification declared in env/qa.json and env/prod.json, and apply it in FindTool.execute (src/tools/mongodb/read/find.ts:108-118) and AggregateTool.execute (src/tools/mongodb/read/aggregate.ts:187-192) before EJSON.stringify returns documents to the MCP client, so classified client fields never reach an agent verbatim. Mask at serialisation only; stored documents must not be altered. Cover find and aggregate with vitest unit tests over fixtures with known classified fields (unit-tests is a blocking CI gate per sdlc/policy.json ciGates). Roll out through the releaseProcess environmentsOrder dev, then qa, then prod, with one approval and a rollback plan; no deployment windows or change freezes are configured in sdlc/policy.json.
acceptanceCriteria: A shared masking module (for example src/common/masking.ts) exists in mongodb-mcp-server and unit tests assert that fields classified pii or financial are replaced with redacted placeholders before EJSON serialisation
A vitest case running FindTool and AggregateTool against fixtures with known classified fields asserts the returned EJSON payload contains masked values and passes in CI
Re-running probe-schemas on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server returns no SCH-API-03 result for src/tools/mongodb/read/find.ts or src/tools/mongodb/read/aggregate.ts

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-schemas on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server and read the SARIF export; expected result: zero SCH-API-03 results for src/tools/mongodb/read/find.ts and src/tools/mongodb/read/aggregate.ts at the new pinned commit

rootCause.description: FindTool.execute and AggregateTool.execute (first-party code at commit aaa72a0) serialise entire cursor results with EJSON.stringify and return them verbatim; only byte and document count limits were ever applied, with no data-minimisation step for the pii and financial classes declared for this app
